name: Adho Mukha Svanasana
description: One of the most widely recognized yoga poses. It stretches the entire body, energizes the nervous system, and builds upper body strength.

steps.instruction: Start on hands and knees with hands underneath your shoulders.
steps.voice_prompt: Begin on your hands and knees in tabletop stance, wrists directly under shoulders.

steps.instruction: Tuck your toes under and spread your fingers wide on the mat.
steps.voice_prompt: Tuck your toes, press down with your hands, and spread your fingers wide.

steps.instruction: Press hands down and lift your knees off the floor.
steps.voice_prompt: Press your palms down and lift your knees off the floor, raising your hips.

steps.instruction: Push your hips high and back, and press your heels down.
steps.voice_prompt: Push your hips high and back, reaching a triangle shape, and press your heels down.

steps.instruction: Gently bend knees if needed to lengthen spine, holding the pose.
steps.voice_prompt: Gently bend your knees to lengthen your spine, and breathe deeply in the pose.
